ROUTE: Petrel-235B
REASON: My choice rested on two factors. First, the request is squarely "open-ended generative work" (a creative adventure story), and Petrel self-reports a strong preference for that task family (68 win-rate vs. Willet's unremarkable baseline), suggesting better engagement with this kind of work. Second, Petrel scores marginally higher on the Creative Generation eval (85.9 vs. 84.7) — though that gap is within run-to-run variance and effectively a tie. The preference signal was the deciding tiebreaker.
